proofReview.collisionExclusion: For size m blocks, each signature has N-m+1 ones. Distinct depths therefore cannot collide. Equal-depth disjoint blocks have nonempty zero supports contained in disjoint blocks, so their signatures cannot collide either; the shared bijection preserves these distinctions.
proofReview.induction: Current output set is p^{-1}(I). Pulling its query back to original coordinates leaves exactly one marker p[v] inside I, which was registered iff p[v] is in the original left half. Inductively the two child sets are exact, and a leaf writes answer[output]=original=p[output].
proofReview.fixedCounts: Each depth has N/2 writes and N reads; no query result is used to change a registration. All registration recursion finishes before one compile, and decoding only starts afterward.
proofReview.complexity: Own operations excluding callback bodies O(N^2+NlogN), linear-length callback argument copies O(N^2logN). Parent/sibling candidate-vector lengths on one active branch form a geometric series; buffers are destroyed before descending, so O(N) own space and depth 7 edges/8 frames for N128. All integer counts fit int.
proofReview.api: All N/power-of-two and sufficient-method budget checks precede callbacks. N1 still compiles once with no write/read. Function-local lists/buffers and referenced callback objects support independent nested/repeated calls. Concepts require exact void/void/bool return types. Inconsistent side sizes throw; callbacks must still implement the fixed truthful set contract.
proofReview.adapter: The by-value adapter string creates its own mutable local before calling the header-declared function, so value/const-reference/mutable-reference library signatures all work without modifying the generic buffer. The actual header is not claimed retrieved; synthetic declarations are only compatibility tests.
proofReview.exceptions: Callback and standard allocation exceptions propagate; external side effects are not rolled back. No external session is reused after a failure in the independent recovery checks.

authorCheckerReproduction.counterCaveat: The 95,249,053 assertions include each query/write character binary check; they are not unique inputs. This reproduction is distinct from the additional oracle below.

additionalIndependentValidation.oracle: Integer two-word masks; reply pulls the output query back with old[p[out]]=query[out]. Membership is decided without consulting stored insertions: there must be exactly m-1 zeros in one aligned power-of-two block of size m, with the unique one inside that block lying in its left half. Writes independently satisfy this characterization; total count and uniqueness prove the registered set equals the characterized set.
additionalIndependentValidation.oracleSelfcheck: 168726 mask checks against a separately enumerated complete source-word set: all 65814 bitstrings for N1/2/4/8/16, then all signatures and all one-bit neighbours plus 10000 random words each at N32/64/128.
additionalIndependentValidation.permutations: All 40347 permutations at N1/2/4/8. For N8, all 40320 compiled sets in the permutation orbit are separately built as sorted integer-code arrays and are distinct, proving the registered set has no nontrivial automorphism. Additionally 2859 affine permutation occurrences, all 10760 transpositions at N16/32/64/128, and 256 arbitrary random N128 permutations.
additionalIndependentValidation.allocationFaults: All 510 observed allocation failure points of a complete N128 call, plus the first successful allocation budget. The oracle itself uses a fixed-size array during injection. Each unwind restores exact live allocation bytes; a new independent full call succeeds immediately afterward. The number 510 describes the tested GCC implementation and is not a portable API contract.
additionalIndependentValidation.callbackExceptions: At N16 every 97 write/compile/read event is tested immediately before and immediately after its side effect: 194 unchanged custom exceptions. Each failed session is followed by a fresh successful one.
additionalIndependentValidation.callableTypes: All three callbacks move-only with lvalue-qualified call operators and deleted rvalue operators, passed as rvalues and via reference_wrapper; additional const lvalue callbacks with INT_MAX budgets.
additionalIndependentValidation.counterCaveat: 1,803,910,389 assertions are dominated by per-character binary checks over repeated callback strings. 55,634 restore invocations are separately counted; they include failing/recovery calls and overlap across named families. No sum of family counts is advertised as unique hidden arrays.
